description:
ownedDay is written twice, once in the programs route and once in the sessions route, both joining program_day to program to check user ownership. It is an authorization check, which makes a divergence between the two copies a security bug rather than an inconsistency.

Two concrete call sites exist, which is exactly the threshold RULES 8 sets for deduplicating: not before, and not "just in case".
title: De-duplicate ownedDay into a shared module
